Subject: Transition plan & kick-off — SummitTech / Redwood

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the smooth contract signature last week. We're aiming to start the integration window in late June and want to align on milestones, the canary approach, and training for our SRE and product teams. Can you share a suggested timeline and the MAP items we should track on our side vs. Redwood's?

Key constraints from SummitTech:
- Production-facing canary should be a two-week gradual traffic shift with rollback points.
- SSO (SAML) has to be validated before any live traffic.
- Telemetry must be available in our Splunk instance (we'll provide ingestion details).

Would appreciate a draft MAP and a kickoff slot this week if possible. I've attached our internal rollout calendar for visibility (internal file) — will forward to you if helpful.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Li
Head of Platform Engineering, SummitTech
emma.li@summittech.com

Emma — thanks for the clear constraints. Drafting a compact MAP and proposed kickoff agenda now. Quick summary below and attaching the living MAP workbook (SummitTech-MAP-v1.xlsx) and our implementation playbook excerpt.

Proposed high-level timeline (can be shortened if you want an accelerated cadence):
- Week 0 (Jun 19-23): Pre-kickoff tasks (SAML details, Splunk ingestion config, account-level whitelists)
- Week 1 (Jun 26-30): Internal staging integration + smoke tests (no customer traffic)
- Weeks 2-3 (Jul 1-14): Canary window — ramp 5% -> 25% -> 50% across two weeks, with nightly health gates
- Week 4 (Jul 15-21): Full cutover window and training sessions for SRE & Product

Owners (sample):
- SummitTech: SAML attributes, Splunk endpoint, release approvals
- Redwood: Canary orchestration, KV cache priming, rollback playbooks
- Joint: Acceptance tests/smoke criteria, runbook handoff

Open questions:
1) Do you have a preferred weekly cadence for status? (we usually do Tue/Thu 30m during canary)
2) Who will be the SummitTech point for sign-offs on each ramp step?

Next steps: I'll schedule a 45-minute kickoff for Thursday if that works — invite will include the MAP workbook and an editable mutual-action tab.

Cheers,
Jordan

Jordan / Emma — adding the implementation checklist that we use for MAPs so everyone has a single source of truth. Key sections I've populated in the attached workbook: acceptance criteria, rollback triggers, canary SLOs, and training curriculum. A few practical notes:

- Canary specifics: we'll run three ramp steps (5%, 25%, 60%) with an automated rollback if error rate > 1.5% over 10m or latency P95 increases by >40%. We can parameterize those numbers in the MAP.
- Migration approach: cold migration of cache and a short warmup period; expect a transient token spike — we'll coordinate alerts to your SREs.
- Training: two 90-minute sessions (SRE deep-dive + product admin walkthrough) the week of Jul 15; recorded sessions will be available.

I've also attached a SOC2 evidence stub for the SSO questionnaire. For SAML we need the metadata URL and a test IdP account — Emma, can you confirm who will share those details?

I'll join the kickoff and lead the runbook review. Jordan, go ahead and book the Thurs slot and include our Ops Runbook doc link.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Team — booking confirmed: Thu Jun 8, 10:00-10:45 PT (kickoff). Invite sent. Below is the mutual-action summary we'll walk through; I've also linked the MAP in the invite for live edits.

Mutual action summary (high level):
- Pre-kickoff (owner / due):
  * SummitTech / Tom — SAML metadata + test IdP (due Jun 9)
  * SummitTech / Platform — Splunk endpoint & firewall rules (due Jun 12)
  * Redwood / Marissa — Updated MAP workbook with acceptance gates & runbook (done)

- Staging integration (Redwood ownership):
  * Deploy staging model variant, run smoke tests, validate tokenization and latency baselines (Jun 26-30)

- Canary execution (joint):
  * Ramp plan: 5% (day 1), 25% (day 4), 60% (day 9) with nightly health snap checks. Gates: error rate, P95 latency, data integrity checks. Rolling back to previous variant on gate failures. (Jul 1-14)

- Training & Handoff (Redwood-led):
  * SRE deep dive + admin walkthrough — Jul 16 & Jul 17 (90 mins each); recordings and runbook delivered same week.

- Cutover & Closeout:
  * Full traffic cutover window Jul 18-21; joint sign-off and retrospective week of Jul 22.

Immediate asks for kickoff: confirm Tom (point for SAML) and your preferred channel for runbook alerts (PagerDuty webhook vs. Slack). We'll show the canary dashboard and the fail-open/fail-closed scenarios in the call.

Thanks all — looking forward to the call.

Jordan
